title: TypeError: Object of type Prompt is not JSON serializable – uploading learning
body: When trying to upload learning if it worked or not it can't serialize the "Prompt" class @TheoMcCabe do you think we could have a fix? (for now I think it's OK to serialize by just saying `has_image: true`)

linked_prs.title: fix learning upload
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/gpt_engineer/applications/cli/learning.py b/gpt_engineer/applications/cli/learning.py
index eb183c5180..d9a7cbc8aa 100644
--- a/gpt_engineer/applications/cli/learning.py
+++ b/gpt_engineer/applications/cli/learning.py
@@ -79,7 +79,7 @@ class Learning:
     Attributes
     ----------
     prompt : str
-        The initial prompt provided to the GPT Engineer.
+        A JSON string representing the prompt provided to GPT Engineer.
     model : str
         The name of the model used during the session.
     temperature : float
@@ -98,7 +98,7 @@ class Learning:
         The version of the learning data schema.
     """
 
-    prompt: Prompt
+    prompt: str
     model: str
     temperature: float
     config: str
@@ -266,7 +266,7 @@ def extract_learning(
         An instance of Learning containing all the session details and user feedback.
     """
     return Learning(
-        prompt=prompt,
+        prompt=prompt.to_json(),
         model=model,
         temperature=temperature,
         config=json.dumps(config),
diff --git a/gpt_engineer/core/prompt.py b/gpt_engineer/core/prompt.py
index 675a22daf5..4d8286343c 100644
--- a/gpt_engineer/core/prompt.py
+++ b/gpt_engineer/core/prompt.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import json
+
 from typing import Dict, Optional
 
 
@@ -30,3 +32,13 @@ def to_langchain_content(self):
                 content.append(image_content)
 
         return content
+
+    def to_dict(self):
+        return {
+            "text": self.text,
+            "image_urls": self.image_urls,
+            "entrypoint_prompt": self.entrypoint_prompt,
+        }
+
+    def to_json(self):
+        return json.dumps(self.to_dict())
diff --git a/tests/applications/cli/test_learning.py b/tests/applications/cli/test_learning.py
index 3e1feae054..4fb6f8ebaf 100644
